title: Usage examples
responsibility: Shows documented examples as short titles and code with expected output comments.

inputs.name: EntityExamples.documentation
inputs.description: Documentation read from this entity at the selected commit; absent or invalid content shows a gap.

inputs.name: EntityExamples.setupTitle
inputs.description: Optional heading for the authored construction snippet before example calls.

inputs.name: EntityExamples.recorded
inputs.type: { evidence: ExplorerEvidence; scope: ExplorerScope; mediaBase: string } | undefined
inputs.description: Optional selected-revision media context; generated clips remain separate from authored expectations.

outputs.name: EntityExamples
outputs.description: Authored example calls and expected results, optional construction guidance, stated documentation gaps and separately attributed generated audio.
